program.department: Environmental Systems Program (Scripps Institution of Oceanography, UC San Diego)

notes: The only B.A. track. Corroborated against the 2019-20 registrar catalog. CORRECTIONS to harvested lower division: (1) SIO 50 is NOT required for this track and was removed; (2) the math requirement is MATH 10A-B (or 20A-B) and MATH 11 (with Econ 120A or Math 183 as an alternative to Math 11) - NOT MATH 20A-B-C-D as harvested; (3) physics is the PHYS 1 lab series OR PHYS 2A-B-C. ECON 1 and ECON 2 both required (verified). Upper-division core (ESYS 101/102/103, ECON 131, POLI 160AA, ESYS 190A/190B; no additional science core) and the 5-course elective list are verified verbatim.

buckets.label: Physics sequence
buckets.note: Accepted: PHYS 2A-B-C, OR the PHYS 1A+1AL / 1B+1BL / 1C+1CL series. Canonical set shown here.

buckets.label: Calculus sequence
buckets.note: 19-20 catalog: MATH 10A-B (or 20A-B) and MATH 11 (Econ 120A or Math 183 may substitute for Math 11). Corrected from harvested MATH 20A-D.

buckets.label: Principles of Economics
buckets.note: ECON 1 is common core; ECON 2 is an additional lower-division requirement specific to the Environmental Policy track (verified).

buckets.label: Senior Project & Senior Seminar
buckets.note: Capstone. 190A = two-quarter, 8-unit senior project; 190B = senior seminar.

buckets.label: Environmental Policy advanced electives
buckets.note: Choose 5 (verified verbatim) from economics, political science, environmental studies (ENVR), history of science, anthropology, communication, philosophy, and urban planning options.
